title: Find your way through a research paper
objective: Identify the job of each section and tell a research report from a review.

slides.title: What kind of article is this?
body: A research report describes a question, a study and its results.
A review brings findings from several papers together. Look at the abstract to see what the authors did.

slides.title: Follow one class study
body: Introduction: Does our garden have more butterflies in the morning?
Methods: We watched for ten minutes at two times.
Results: We saw 6 butterflies in the morning and 2 later.
Discussion: The time of day may matter. More visits would help.

slides.title: Read the first case together
body: Classroom text: We asked where snails were common. We counted snails by two ponds. Pond A had eight and Pond B had three. The banks may differ in shade.

slides.title: Try it with a partner
body: Which sentence belongs in Methods? Explain your choice.
Give one result. Name the section where a reader would find it.
Look for what the team did.

slides.title: Try a new case
body: Classroom text: We asked where birds were common. We counted birds in two gardens. Garden A had seven and Garden B had three. The gardens may differ in food.

slides.title: Work on your own
body: Which sentence belongs in Methods? Explain your choice.
Give one result. Name the section where a reader would find it.
Which section gives a possible reason for the result? Give the possible reason in this text.

slides.title: Name the job of a sentence
body: Choose a sentence from the second case. Say which section it fits and which words helped you decide.
